name: What do I need to prepare before custom framing starts on my home?

mainEntity.name: What do I need to prepare before custom framing starts on my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before framing begins, you should have a finalized floor plan, including appliance layouts, fixture locations, and door swing preferences. Measure and select your planned cabinetry, bathtubs, shower pans, and pocket doors so exact rough openings can be framed correctly from the start. You will also need to decide on ceiling heights and architectural details like recessed shelving niches. Having these selections decided upfront avoids costly carpentry rework, reframing, and delay once drywall and electrical rough-ins are underway.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finalize your floor plan and choose fixtures, doors, and cabinet dimensions upfront so rough openings and wall blocking are built correctly from day one.
